parameters.jsCode: const original=$('INT | Governed Email Delivery Adapter').item.json; let a=$json.email_authorization??null; if(typeof a==='string'){try{a=JSON.parse(a)}catch{a=null}} return {...original,email_authorization:a??{allowed:false,reason:'EMAIL_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID'}};
